note: Subject texts of the Steampunk Dwarf faction (bead pulp_wars-78i.5, docs/art/factions/DWARF.md). The faction has fixed colours: soot-black iron with a light rim, copper about #c27c3a, dark leather, white steam and ginger-copper beards about #c8642a; no owner colour.

subjects.UNIT:DWARF:FIGHTER: Subject: Hammerer, a chunky cute dwarf warrior, very short and very broad, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a friendly face with light peach skin, a big round nose and small eyes, a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, wider than his shoulders and reaching his belt, a round riveted soot-black iron helmet with a copper rim and round goggles pushed up on it, a dark brown leather apron over a soot-black iron chest plate, copper bracers and soot-black iron boots; one oversized two-handed war hammer with a big riveted soot-black iron head banded in copper, held across his body; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a dwarf, not a wizard.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:RAIDER: Subject: Gyrocopter, a chunky cute small flying machine: a small open seat frame of soot-black iron tubes with one small dwarf pilot sitting in it, wearing round goggles and a dark leather cap, with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a; one big flat two-blade rotor on a short mast above the pilot; a small copper engine with a short smokestack puffing a white steam cloud behind the seat; a short tail boom with a little propeller; one round black bomb hanging under the seat; two thin iron landing skids under it; an open frame of tubes, never a disc or a saucer; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:MARKSMAN: Subject: Clockwork Gunner, a chunky cute round wind-up automaton the size of a dwarf, with no dwarf inside: a round soot-black riveted iron body like a kettle with a round bright copper boiler belly and one small white-faced pressure gauge on the chest, a small domed soot-black iron head with two round glass eye lenses and no face, no beard and no mouth, short stubby iron legs with big iron feet, one arm a short copper gatling gun with several barrels held forward, the other a simple iron claw, a big copper wind-up key sticking out of its back, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on its head; a thin light warm grey highlight along its lit iron edges; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a machine, not a person.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:GUARD: Subject: Steam Mole, a chunky cute squat drilling machine: a round riveted soot-black iron tub on two short dark iron tracks, with one huge cone-shaped bright copper drill with spiral grooves on its front pointing forward, a short copper smokestack on top puffing a small white steam cloud, a small round hatch on top with a goggled dwarf with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, peeking out, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on its side; a thin light warm grey highlight along the lit iron edges; wide and low; simple shapes and very few details; the tracks are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:CAPTAIN: Subject: Engineer, a chunky cute dwarf mechanic, very short and very broad, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a friendly face with light peach skin and a big round nose, a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, reaching his belt, round goggles pushed up on a dark brown leather cap, a dark brown leather tool apron with tools in its pockets, a small round copper boiler on his back with a short smokestack puffing a white steam cloud, soot-black iron boots; one oversized iron wrench, longer than he is tall, held over his shoulder, and a copper cog under his other arm; no helmet and no weapon; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a dwarf, not a wizard.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Brass Titan, a huge towering chunky clockwork giant of bright copper plates and soot-black riveted iron, with no dwarf inside, far taller than a dwarf: a small domed soot-black iron head with two round glass eye lenses and no face, no beard and no mouth, a broad barrel chest of bright copper plates with a round iron furnace door with a grille and a white-faced pressure gauge, huge riveted iron shoulders and arms ending in big iron fists, thick iron legs with big iron feet, two short copper smokestacks on its back puffing white steam, a big copper wind-up key on its back, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on its head; a thin light warm grey highlight along the lit iron edges; copper and iron despite its name, never brass or gold; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:FIGHTER: Subject: Hammerer portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute dwarf warrior: a friendly face with light peach skin, a big round nose and small eyes, a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, filling the bottom of the square, a round riveted soot-black iron helmet with a copper rim and round goggles pushed up on it, soot-black iron shoulder plates, and the riveted iron head of a war hammer banded in copper raised beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:RAIDER: Subject: Gyrocopter, a chunky cute small flying machine shown whole: a small soot-black iron pod with a goggled dwarf pilot with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, one big flat two-blade rotor above, a small copper engine with a white steam puff, a short tail, a round black bomb under the seat, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on the pod; flying with nothing under it.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:MARKSMAN: Subject: Clockwork Gunner portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute wind-up automaton with no dwarf inside: a small domed soot-black iron head with two round glass eye lenses and no face, no beard and no mouth, a bright green signal lamp, colour #2bd94a, on top of the head, round riveted iron shoulders, a round copper boiler chest with a small white-faced gauge, a big copper wind-up key behind the shoulder, and the copper barrels of its gatling arm beside it.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:GUARD: Subject: Steam Mole, a chunky cute squat drilling machine shown whole: a round riveted soot-black iron tub on short dark tracks, one huge cone-shaped bright copper drill with spiral grooves pointing forward, a short copper stack with a white steam puff, a goggled dwarf with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, in the hatch, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on its side.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:CAPTAIN: Subject: Engineer portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute dwarf mechanic: a friendly face with light peach skin and a big round nose, a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, round goggles pushed up on a dark brown leather cap, a dark brown leather apron strap, the top of a small copper boiler with a white steam puff behind the shoulder, and a big iron wrench resting on the shoulder.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:CATAPULT: Subject: Steam Cannon, a chunky cute short fat cannon shown whole: a short fat soot-black iron barrel with copper bands pointing forward on a low closed carriage with two iron wheels, a round copper boiler with a white steam puff and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, and one goggled dwarf gunner with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, behind it.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:KNIGHT: Subject: Steam Tank, a chunky cute round steam tank shown whole: a big domed body of soot-black riveted iron with a bright copper band, a short thick cannon snout, a tall copper smokestack with a big white steam cloud, a goggled dwarf with a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, in the top hatch, and one small bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a, on the dome.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Brass Titan portrait, head and shoulders of a huge chunky clockwork giant with no dwarf inside: a domed soot-black iron head with two round glass eye lenses and no face, no beard and no mouth, a bright green signal lamp, colour #2bd94a, on top of the head, huge riveted soot-black iron shoulders, a broad bright copper chest with a round iron furnace door, two short copper stacks with white steam and a copper wind-up key behind the shoulders; copper and iron, never brass or gold.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:TUNNEL: Subject: one big cone-shaped bright copper drill bit with dark spiral grooves, pointing down and diving into a small heap of dark brown earth, with a few clods of dirt flying up beside it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BOMB_RUN: Subject: one round black iron bomb with a short copper fuse cap falling straight down, under a small flat two-blade rotor spinning above it, with two short white motion lines beside the bomb; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:ASSEMBLE: Subject: one big bright copper wind-up key, a short shaft with a flat round handle with two round holes, crossed over one soot-black iron cog wheel, with one small white steam puff; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:DWARF:TEND_WOUNDED: Subject: one big soot-black iron wrench with a light grey shine, set at an angle, with three small bright white and pale yellow sparks flying from its jaw; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:KNOCKBACK: Subject: one short fat soot-black iron cannon ball flying to the right with a big white steam puff behind it and one thick white curved arrow showing a push to the right; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:PLATED: Subject: one thick square plate of soot-black riveted iron with a light grey rim, a big rivet in each corner and a bright copper band across it, with a small dent in its middle; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:CLOCKWORK: Subject: one bold copper cog wheel with eight square teeth and a round hole in the middle; flat and simple, symmetrical; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:DUG_IN: Subject: a low ring of piled dark brown earth and pale tan sandbags seen from a little above, round and empty in the middle; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:DWARF:FORTIFICATION: Subject: Dig In: one iron shovel with a short iron handle stuck upright in the middle of a low round ring of piled dark brown earth and two pale tan sandbags; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:DWARF:EXPLOSIVES: Subject: Blasting Charges: one fat cylindrical blasting charge in a bright copper case with soot-black iron bands, a pointed drill tip at its bottom and a short fuse with a small white spark on top; nothing else in the image.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:MOUND: Subject: a burrow mound: one low wide round heap of freshly dug dark brown earth with a few small grey rocks, the shining tip of a big cone-shaped copper drill with dark spiral grooves breaking up through its top, and one small puff of white steam rising from a crack beside it; wider than tall; the bottom of the heap is the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:MOUND_RIDER: Subject: a burrow mound with a rider: one low wide round heap of freshly dug dark brown earth with a few small grey rocks, the shining tip of a big cone-shaped copper drill breaking up through its top, and beside it the riveted soot-black iron head of a war hammer banded in copper sticking up out of the earth, with one small puff of white steam; wider than tall; the bottom of the heap is the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:ERUPTION: Subject: a burst of earth bursting up from the ground: many chunky dark brown clods of dirt and grey rocks flying up and outward in a tall fan from one point, with a big round puff of pale dust and white steam at its foot and a few small bright sparks; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:ERUPTION_RING: Subject: a ring of flying dirt seen from above: one wide flat round ring made of chunky dark brown clods of earth, small grey rocks and puffs of pale dust, with empty space in its middle; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:BOMB_BLAST: Subject: a small round bomb blast: one round puff of dark grey smoke with a bright copper and pale yellow flash in its middle, a few flying black iron shards and a ring of white steam around it; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:STEAM_PUFF: Subject: one round fluffy puff of pure white steam made of four soft round lumps with light grey shading; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:REPAIR_SPARKS: Subject: a small spray of bright sparks: six short pale yellow and white spark streaks flying out from one point in a fan, with two tiny copper glints; floating in empty space.
subjects.CITY:DWARF:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 mountain hold, the first of three sizes of one settlement: one squat hall of warm grey stone blocks built into a small grey rock outcrop, with a round dark riveted iron door, a small roof of muted copper, one short stone chimney with a small white steam puff, and one thin tall dark iron pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no wall, no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DWARF:2/CALM: Subject: a medium level-2 forge town, the second of three sizes of one settlement: a hall of warm grey stone blocks cut into a grey rock hillside with a big round dark riveted iron gate, two small stone houses with muted copper roofs, one forge chimney with a white steam puff, a big muted copper cog set in the hall's wall, packed tightly inside a low wall of grey stone banded with dark iron, and one thin tall dark iron pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DWARF:3/CALM: Subject: a large level-3 mountain fortress city, the biggest of three sizes of one settlement, crowded and grand: a big gatehouse of warm grey stone cut into a grey rock mountainside with a huge round dark riveted iron gate between two stone towers with domed muted copper roofs, several stone halls with muted copper roofs filling it from side to side, three tall chimneys with white steam puffs, a big copper cog and pipes on the walls, inside a wall of grey stone banded with dark iron, and one thin very tall dark iron pole standing at the right with nothing on it; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Dwarves, a chunky cute small iron-clad steam paddle boat seen from the front-right: a short round hull of soot-black riveted iron plates with a light warm grey rim, one tall copper smokestack puffing white steam in place of a mast and sail, a copper paddle wheel on its side, and one small bright signal-green lamp; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Dwarves, a chunky cute big riveted steam ironclad seen from the front-right: a long hull of soot-black riveted iron plates with a light warm grey rim and a copper band, a squat iron gun turret with a short cannon, two tall copper smokestacks puffing white steam, and small bright signal-green lamps; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Dwarves, a chunky cute wide low steam barge seen from the front-right: a soot-black riveted iron hull, cargo under a dark brown leather tarp tied with copper bands, one short copper smokestack puffing white steam at the stern, and one small bright signal-green lamp; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Dwarves shown whole from the front-right: a small soot-black riveted iron steam paddle boat with a tall copper smokestack and white steam, a copper paddle wheel and a small green lamp; no water.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DWARF:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Dwarves shown whole from the front-right: a big soot-black riveted steam ironclad with a squat gun turret, two copper smokestacks with white steam and small green lamps; no water.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:CATAPULT: Subject: Steam Cannon, a chunky cute short fat cannon on a low closed carriage of soot-black riveted iron plates with two big iron wheels: a short fat soot-black iron barrel with copper bands pointing forward, a round copper boiler with a short smokestack puffing a white steam cloud behind the barrel, and two small dwarf gunners with round goggles and huge bushy ginger-copper beards, colour #c8642a, standing behind it; a solid closed iron carriage, never an open wooden frame; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DWARF:KNIGHT: Subject: Steam Tank, a chunky cute round steam tank: a big domed body of soot-black riveted iron plates like an upturned kettle, with rows of rivets and a bright copper band around the dome, on four small iron wheels; a short thick iron cannon snout pointing forward; one tall copper smokestack on top puffing a big white steam cloud; a small round hatch on top with a dwarf's head in round goggles and a huge bushy ginger-copper beard, colour #c8642a, peeking out; closed and domed, never an open frame; simple shapes and very few details.
